component.$description: Component-level tokens. The design-token foundation declared component tokens a non-goal (add-dtcg-design-tokens, Non-Goals); issue #838 relaxes that for the one component that genuinely needs its own value: the pushed-screen header. Rules for a future addition: (1) a component group may only reference primitive/semantic tokens via aliases where a primitive already owns the value, (2) it states only the decision no primitive can state (e.g. a clamp), (3) every value here is read from the generated artifact by hand-authored code, never re-derived at a call site. OpenSpec change 838-appbar-component-token.

appBar.$description: The header of every pushed screen (issue #824's BreakdownAppBar, themed once in lib/design/theme.dart). Height is the design decision; the type and padding values alias the primitives they are built from, so retuning the type scale or spacing scale flows into the header token without a second edit here.

height.$description: The header's height: 48 dp. This is the decision the primitives cannot state — it is the Material 48 dp interactive floor, which the derived content height (titleLineHeight 28 + 2 × verticalPadding 8 = 44) does NOT reach, and the leading back button's touch target lives inside the bar. Retuning the type scale or the padding must keep titleLineHeight + 2 × verticalPadding below this value; test/design/header_metrics_test.dart asserts that invariant. HeaderMetrics.toolbarHeight reads this token; no arithmetic constant remains in code.

titleFontSize.$description: Header title font size — alias of typography.fontSize.titleLarge (22 sp).

titleLineHeight.$description: Header title line height — alias of typography.lineHeight.titleLarge (28 dp).

verticalPadding.$description: Breathing room above and below the title line — alias of size.space.8 (8 dp).
